desc:
It's 66 million years ago. This Dino will help me survive this prehistoric apocalyptic world full of zombies... and rescue my beloved pet, Usagi. 🦖🐱

What happens when the zombie virus reaches the Stone Age? Dead Age

Grab your friends, because nobody should face the apocalypse alone!
